Committee: Healthcare
Sponsor: McClendon
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 03/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 302 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama State Board of Occupational Therapy by an undetermined amount to develop a program to promote early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of any impaired licensee and to provide operational expenses, including actual cost of travel, office overhead, and personnel expenses, to members of the Alabama Occupational Therapy Wellness Committee created by this bill.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
Healthcare
